title: Virtualization, Containers, and Isolation
learning_outcomes: Distinguish VMs from containers and explain namespace isolation, resource controls, networking, storage, and runtime security.
Apply the module concepts to a safe example and verify the observed result.
Identify at least one distribution/version difference or operational safety concern.
